standard_deliverables: Visual graphic assets and copy drafts
common_out_of_scope_items: Responding directly to DM support messages
Paid social media ad account operations
revision_policy: Includes one round of adjustments for each monthly content calendar.

milestones.condition: Due monthly in advance on the 1st of each service month

risk_rules.risk: Late client asset delivery pauses feed
risk_rules.recommended_fix: Add clause that post calendar will repeat evergreen posts if assets are not received 5 days before scheduled date.
State that algorithm changes are out of agency control and reports will focus on direct engagement metrics.
Define whether engagement, moderation, and inbox management are included.
Separate organic content scope from paid campaign management and ad spend.

client_responsibilities: Provide product and brand media assets
Review and approve draft calendars within review windows
Provide credentials to scheduling platforms safely
timeline_assumptions: Post calendars are submitted for review by the 20th of the preceding month.
Approvals are granted within 3 working days of submission.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly post calendar is fully approved.
Graphics and copy align with brand guidelines.

revision: Edits to scheduled posts after approval and scheduling must be requested at least 24 hours prior to post times.
payment: Campaign execution will pause if monthly retainer invoices remain unpaid for more than 5 days.
out_of_scope: Managing additional channels (e.g. YouTube, newsletters) is outside the scope of this retainer.
client_responsibilities: Client is responsible for providing all legal credentials and assets necessary to execute posting calendars.
ip_ownership: Final visual assets belong to the client, while analytical strategy templates remain the property of the agency.
change_request: Requests to add additional emergency posts outside the monthly calendar scope will require separate fees.
Any request that changes approved deliverables, timing, assumptions, or acceptance criteria requires written approval before work begins.
timeline: Posting schedules may shift temporarily to align with platform outages or major industry events.
Milestones depend on timely client feedback, access, content, approvals, and third-party provider availability.

hidden_scope_traps: Community management expected beyond publishing or content calendar scope
Realtime trend responses requested without retainer allocation
Paid media management assumed inside organic content package
Client approvals delayed until scheduled publishing windows are missed
